title: Jensen Huang back at Nvidia, stock soars; Anthropic slides
summary: The 8:30 team is joined by Roundhill Investments Chief Investment Strategist Drew Pettit to discuss why washed-out sentiment doesn't mean a fundamental bottom, his $50-to-$250 bull-bear range on Anthropic, and how to handicap the "Jensen premium" coming back into Nvidia. Deirdre Bosa Live host Deirdre Bosa also joins to break down Silicon Valley's reaction to Huang's return and what it means for the AI trade.
